checks: summary_non_empty: summary is at least 10 chars
mentions_qualified_name_or_identifier: the chunk's qualified name or any identifier of length >3 appears in the summary
no_refusal: none of ["i'm sorry", 'i am sorry', 'i cannot', "i can't", 'unable to assist', 'as an ai', "i don't have access", 'cannot assist'] appear

doc.summary: Defines FlaskyStyle, a Pygments syntax-highlighting style (subclass of pygments Style) based on the Tango palette, used by the Flask documentation Sphinx theme.
key_behaviors: Maps Pygments token types (keywords, strings, names, comments, generics) to Tango-style colors and formatting
Sets a light background color #f8f8f8 with empty default style
Makes docstrings render like comments (italic brown) and name classes look like plain variables
Purely declarative data module with no functions or runtime logic
doc.complexity_note: Straightforward declarative style table; only risk is Pygments API drift (e.g., default_style deprecated or token renames) breaking docs builds.

doc.summary: Tests that morsel_to_cookie correctly converts a cookie morsel with a valid integer max-age (60 seconds) into a cookie object.
key_behaviors: Sets morsel max-age to a valid integer (60)
Asserts the resulting cookie's expires attribute is an int

doc.summary: Provides a context manager that temporarily overrides one or more environment variables and restores the original environment on exit; passing None deletes a variable instead of setting it.
key_behaviors: Sets each given key/value pair in os.environ for the duration of the with block
Deletes an env var when None is passed as its value
Saves the full environment on entry and restores it via clear+update in finally, so restoration happens even on exceptions
doc.complexity_note: Mutates global process state and restores the whole environment rather than only touched keys, so concurrent env changes made inside the block are silently discarded.
